source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U08: Apply title,description,sample,quiet possession and encumbrance rules

payload.title: Conformity has more than one dimension
payload.core_explanation_md:
A transaction can require conformity to description,to sample,or to both. Matching a sample alone does not necessarily satisfy a separate description. The sample route also addresses the opportunity to compare and the described latent defect issue. Identify which representations and terms form part of the contract.

Title,quiet possession and undisclosed encumbrance protections address different risks from quality. Goods that perform well can still have a title problem. A lender should therefore examine seller rights and competing interests as well as inspection results. The precise implied terms and any permitted contractual qualifications require the applicable statutory analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Can quality conformity alone establish clean title?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Quality and title are separate checks.

payload.stem_md: Goods match the inspected sample but fail a separately agreed contractual description. Which analysis is appropriate?

options.text_md: Sample conformity automatically defeats every other term
options.explanation_md: The description can remain a separate requirement.

options.text_md: Examine compliance with both applicable sample and description terms
options.explanation_md: The source distinguishes the combined transaction.

options.text_md: Only the packaging invoice number matters
The buyer necessarily owns all seller goods
options.explanation_md: The breach does not create that consequence.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes the combined transaction.

payload.stem_md: Financed equipment works correctly,but an undisclosed third-party charge is alleged. Which issue remains?

options.text_md: None,because physical performance cures every title issue
Only whether the buyer likes the colour
options.explanation_md: Preference does not resolve legal interests.

options.text_md: The complaint is automatically a minor quality warranty
options.explanation_md: The claim concerns a separate legal risk.
Good operation does not prove an unencumbered interest.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Good operation does not prove an unencumbered interest.
